plan: My private value is $14. To maximize profit, I want to bid strategically. Since the third-highest bid determines my payment if I win, I should bid close to, but not exactly at, my value. A bid slightly above my value gives me room to potentially win while minimizing overpayment. Given the $0-$49 range, I'll aim to bid around $16-$17 to create some buffer above my value but not risk overpaying dramatically.
